scientific_purpose: Trace original UCI501 observation-to-writer identity, delta update, causal retrieval and historic prediction on frozen LATFUSE008; replace opposite-label wrong keys with original same-owner label-blind writes, quantify paired Brier differences against frozen nonassociative and source controls without claiming matched full-training-FLOP architecture superiority.
publisher: UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 501 Beijing Multi-Site Air-Quality Data
source_license: CC BY 4.0; independent source verifier must confirm release and authorized use

cohort.selection: Frozen LATFUSE008 high>=150/ordinary<=35 same-station same-clock 24 pairs; do not reselect from scores

primary_metric: Mean Brier loss for authentic source-observed historical PM2.5 >=150 label; all 48 frozen cases and both seeds; source targets consulted after predictions
controls: Four actual same-owner nonzero directional writes selected strictly between target and query by PR477 identity-only selector; record full pool and selected-hour receipts. Fail absent/duplicate/nonwrite keys, never substitute opposite pair.
read_scope: Native query receives requested past clock and current fast/slow only. Historical target key is privileged offline control; never native input.

analysis.gate: For each seed native Brier must improve >=5% over every baseline, with positive lower station-bootstrap 95% paired-loss-gain bound; exploratory only, no source-independent architecture promotion
analysis.secondary: Report all control scores, trace reconstruction errors, native versus zero-read effect and key/value alignment; geometry alone is not factual-content proof.
